name: Zenith Pulse Pro 5G
description: An upper mid-range performance smartphone featuring a MediaTek Dimensity 8200 chipset, 108MP OIS primary camera with AI portrait modes, 5000mAh battery with 67W Turbo Charge, 120Hz 1.5K curved AMOLED display, 8GB RAM + 256GB storage, and clean Android 14 with on-device security. Engineered for students and young professionals seeking fluid gaming, reliable battery life, and crisp photography.
target_group: College students, gamers, and young working professionals.

features.name: 67W Turbo Charge & 5000mAh
